name: Senthil Iyer
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
HFmrEF
- Status: symptomatic on mild exertion, NYHA II, weight 78 kg, waist 94 cm (>90 cm cutoff).
- Plan: Continue sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, spironolactone 25 mg OD, furosemide 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD. Monitor weight daily, low‑salt diet, fluid restriction 1.5 L/day. Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05, electrolytes & creatinine 2025-04-12, echocardiogram 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
HFmrEF
- Status: increased dyspnea on walking 100 m, weight up 2 kg to 80 kg, mild pulmonary edema on exam. Labs: K 4.7, Cr 1.28, NT‑proBNP 950.
- Investigation: Echocardiogram shows LVEF 30%, NYHA III.
- Plan: Increase furosemide to 60 mg OD, consider uptitrating bisoprolol if BP permits, continue sacubitril/valsartan, spironolactone 12.5 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD. Refer to cardiology for device evaluation. Due: HbA1c 2026-01-20, electrolytes 2025-11-17, repeat echo 2026-01-20.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Cardiology, Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences, Bengaluru. Reason: worsening HFrEF, LVEF 30%, NYHA III, consider CRT‑D or ICD. Please review uptitration of beta‑blocker and MRA, assess for advanced therapies.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2026-01-15 at 10:00 with Dr Hegde (D04) for HF review and pre‑op clearance.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Cardiology reply: Patient reviewed, LVEF 30% confirmed. Recommended CRT‑D implantation. Advised to continue GDMT, aim for bisoprolol 5 mg OD if tolerated, hold spironolactone if K >5.0. Pre‑op clearance labs requested.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
HFmrEF
- Status: weight 79.5 kg, waist 92 cm, no orthopnea, mild fatigue. Labs: K 4.6, Cr 1.22, NT‑proBNP 620.
- Plan: Uptitrate bisoprolol to 3.75 mg OD (half tablet 2.5 mg + 1.25 mg), continue sacubitril/valsartan, hold spironolactone (K borderline), furosemide 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD. Pre‑op clearance pending. Due: HbA1c 2026-04-15, electrolytes 2026-02-12, echo 2026-04-15.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
HFmrEF
- Status: weight 78 kg, waist 90 cm (at cutoff), NYHA II, tolerating bisoprolol 3.75 mg OD. Labs: K 4.4, Cr 1.18, NT‑proBNP 540.
- Investigation: Echocardiogram LVEF 38%, mild improvement.
- Plan: Continue bisoprolol 3.75 mg OD, aim for 5 mg OD in 4 weeks if BP >100 systolic. Continue sacubitril/valsartan, furosemide 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD. Restart spironolactone 12.5 mg OD if K stays <5.0. Due: HbA1c 2026-07-15, electrolytes 2026-07-15, echo 2027-04-15 (annual).
